# Purpose

These answers are representative. Award credit for a correct load path, a three-region axial idealization, internal-force and effective-area identification, consistent use of $\delta=NL/(AE)$, and a bounded engineering interpretation.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes perfect bonding, equal axial strain in overlapping plates, uniform stress over each effective cross section, small deformation, and linear-elastic A992 steel. Bond-line shear and peel stresses, seam-end stress concentrations, local plate bending, yielding, bond slip, fatigue, environmental degradation, and manufacturing details require additional models and data.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

Suggested weighting:

- context interpretation and idealization: 20%;
- load equilibrium and internal-force diagram: 20%;
- effective areas and segment deformation: 35%;
- total displacement and sign convention: 15%;
- engineering assessment and limitations: 10%.
